answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the anchor of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Every claim climbs the crystal of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the meadow re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, published publicly on failure, rewards vest against future work. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short.
